display.label: AWS SNS Topic
display.description: Provision Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) pub/sub topics with KMS encryption and subscriptions

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the SNS topic. Serves as map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Topic name, display name, and FIFO settings.

fields.label: Topic Name
fields.description: The name of the SNS topic. For FIFO topics, the name must end with '.fifo'.

validation.pattern_error: Topic name must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: Name Prefix
fields.description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with name.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.description: The display name for SMS message sender ID.

fields.label: FIFO Topic
fields.description: Designates whether the topic is FIFO (first-in-first-out). Name must end with '.fifo'.

fields.label: Content-Based Deduplication
fields.description: Enables content-based message deduplication for FIFO topics.

sections.label: Encryption & Policies
sections.description: Server-side encryption and IAM access policies.

fields.label: KMS Master Key ID
fields.description: KMS CMK ID, ARN, or alias (e.g., alias/aws/sns) for server-side encryption.

fields.label: Topic IAM Policy
fields.description: The fully-formed IAM Policy document as a JSON string.

fields.label: Delivery Policy
fields.description: SNS delivery retry policy as a JSON string.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Identifies this subscription within the request -- not sent to AWS. Must be unique among this topic's subscriptions.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Format depends on the protocol: an email address, phone number, URL, or the ARN of an SQS queue / Lambda function / Firehose delivery stream.

fields.label: Raw Message Delivery
fields.description: Deliver the raw message body without wrapping it in an SNS JSON envelope. Only meaningful for SQS and HTTP/S endpoints.

fields.label: Filter Policy
fields.description: JSON message filter policy -- only matching messages are delivered to this subscription.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags assigned to the SNS topic.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the SNS topic.
